name: tree-sitter-graphql
description: Vendored copy of tree-sitter-graphql from @fraziym/tree-sitters. The bindings/node/index.js throws when required — axodex catches the throw and reports the grammar as 'unavailable'. Once prebuilds are built via CI (.github/workflows/build.yml), this sub-package will be published with prebuilds and the install script will switch to 'node-gyp-build' which loads the prebuilt .node file directly.
